十月场以 Health & Harmony 为主题，结合现场音乐、本地餐饮、手作: October’s Health & Harmony edition combines live music, local food, makers and community resources, with Art Murmur highlighting Black artists. Walk Telegraph Avenue after work and linger at a performance or a few favorite stalls.

确认场次为 10 月 2 日 17:00–21:30。带孩子可早点到场，同行者先: This confirmed edition is October 2, 5–9:30pm. Families may prefer an earlier visit; choose a meeting point and recheck performances and changes before leaving.

第三十四届 Berkeley Indigenous Peoples Day Po: Berkeley’s 34th Indigenous Peoples Day Powwow and market bring Indigenous dance, crafts and food to Civic Center Park. With a noon land acknowledgement and 1pm Grand Entry, plan around a meaningful program segment rather than rushing through the performance area.
免费入场，官网未列普通观众预约要求；餐饮与手作另购。主办方标注场地可供轮椅使用，: Admission is free, with no general visitor reservation requirement listed. Food and crafts cost extra. Organizers list wheelchair access; contact them about specific access needs.
活动 10:00–18:00，正午土地致谢、13:00 Grand Entry。: The event runs 10am–6pm, with the land acknowledgement at noon and Grand Entry at 1pm. Editorial tip: follow the emcee’s guidance and ask before photographing or joining dances.
到 Allston Way 的 MLK Civic Center Park。编辑: Go to MLK Civic Center Park on Allston Way. Editorial tip: walk from Downtown Berkeley BART, bring water and a layer for the outdoor setting, and plan your return.
